properties.areaDesc: Guam Coastal Waters; Rota Coastal Waters
properties.headline: Typhoon Warning issued October 16 at 4:51PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT....Typhoon conditions, including winds of 64 knots or more
are expected.

* WHERE...Guam Coastal Waters and Rota Coastal Waters.

* WHEN...Onset of damaging winds beginning Saturday night. Onset
of destructive winds Sunday morning. Damaging winds will
continue into at least Sunday night, possibly longer if
conditions warrant.

* IMPACTS...Destructive winds will produce dangerous seas that
could damage, capsize or sink vessels, along with drastically
reducing visibilities in heavy rain.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Tropical Storm Champi (29W) continues to
move quickly toward the Marianas. The exact path of 29W remains
subject to change. However, guidance supports a passage through
Guam coastal waters, with damaging winds moving in Saturday
night and lasting into at least Sunday night. Champi is expected
to strengthen further today and Saturday as it approaches, then
move through the region as a typhoon Sunday morning. Seas will
quickly rise, with significant sea heights reaching as high as
35 feet during closest passage of Champi. Dangerous sea
conditions may continue into Monday.
properties.instruction:
Prepare for the passage of a
typhoon Sunday morning. Secure all vessels. Conditions are
expected to be catastrophic for small craft, and extremely
dangerous for any vessels of larger size. As Tropical Storm Champi
approaches, stay in safe harbor.

NWSheadline: TYPHOON WARNING IN EFFECT
CMAMtext: NWS: TYPHOON WARNING this area. Check media and local authorities.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A TYPHOON WARNING is in effect for this area for dangerous and damaging winds. This warning is issued up to 36 hours before hazardous conditions begin. Urgently complete efforts to protect life and property. Have food, water, cash, fuel, and medications for 3+ days. FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS FROM LOCAL OFFICIALS.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Surf City.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Saturday to 11 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could

vessel for hazardous conditions.

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 15 at 11:41PM MST until October 17 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...East winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 45 to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Apache Junction/Gold Canyon, Dripping Springs, Globe/Miami,
Mazatzal Mountains, Northwest Pinal County, Pinal/Superstition
Mountains, Rio Verde/Salt River, San Carlos, and Superior.

* WHEN...From 5 AM Friday to 11 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Difficult driving conditions, especially for larger
vehicles traveling along roads with crosswinds. Light, unsecured
objects may become airborne. Localized channels of blowing dust may
briefly lower visibility under one mile.
properties.instruction:
A Wind Advisory means that sustained wind speeds of between 30 and 40
mph are expected, or wind gusts of between 40 and 58 mph. Winds this
strong can make driving difficult, especially for high profile
vehicles.

In addition, strong winds over desert areas could result in briefly
lowered visibilities to well under a mile at times in blowing dust or
blowing sand. Use extra caution.
